SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__stunRes: Interrupted Stun rest: a re-test never counts more successes than the first roll (book) or every rest is a fresh test (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__healing: Healing lifestyle: a warning on the rest card when the lifestyle is below the wound's minimum (book) or no check (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__medical: Medical costs: doctor's and paramedic's fees by the Medical Costs Table (book) or hospital and intensive care only (off, v0.95.1)
Medical costs (book): hospital per day (¥, doctor included)
Medical costs (book): intensive care per day (¥)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__healing: Healing spells' time: the Healing Table's turns ÷ the successes put to time (book) or Force ÷ successes (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__antidot: Antidote patch on a dying toxin victim: a GM button for professional attention (book) or nothing (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__patchIm: Slap patches and implants: dermal armor lowers the rating, blood filtration stops them (book) or no effect (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__stimMag: Stim patch and magicians: Magic test against the rating (core), against the 24-hour total (awakenings, optional) or none (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__nephrit: Nephritic screen: −1 Power against pathogens and blood-borne toxins (book) or dice only (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__traumaD: Trauma damper: a Physical hit moves a box onto the Stun track (book) or Stun hits only (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__painEdi: Pain editor: Stun can't knock the wearer out (book) or it can (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__addicti: Addiction: drugs both physically and mentally addictive (book) or one kind only (off, v0.95.1)
Addiction tests: when the dose wears off (wearOff, book) or at the dose (dose, v0.95.1)
Addiction: a rest after recovery at +1 TN (book) or cured at once (off, v0.95.1)
Addiction: the rating drops 1 per 24 hours of forced withdrawal (book) or not (off, v0.95.1)
Addiction: a weekly GM card for ½ Essence and a box of each track (card) or nothing (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__docwago: DocWagon response time: rolled, 3D6 minutes (book) or the contract's fixed minutes (off, v0.95.1)
DocWagon HTR charge: discounted by contract (book) or the tier's own fee (off, v0.95.1)
DocWagon extended care discount: Gold 10%, Platinum 50% (book) or none (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__neuroSt: Neuro-stun: an hour of disorientation, +2 TN (book) or none (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.HEALTH_V96__medkitA: Medkit advice: first aid with a medkit rolls at least its Biotech 3 (book) or the healer's own (off, v0.95.1)
SR2E.Guide.Topic.rulesV096Health.title: Book rules added in v0.96.0: healing, medical bills, patches and addiction
SR2E.Guide.Topic.rulesV096Health.b1: These rules follow the SR2 books and are on by default; each has a switch in the house rules window (search for "v0.95.1" to find the old behaviour).
SR2E.Guide.Topic.rulesV096Health.b2.i1: Resting off Stun: if a rest stops before your Stun track is clear, the next rest rolls again but never counts more successes than the first roll. A clear track starts afresh.
SR2E.Guide.Topic.rulesV096Health.b2.i2: Healing and money: the rest card warns when your lifestyle is below the wound's minimum (Light: Low, Moderate: Middle, Serious: High, Deadly: a hospital). A doctor's care, a hospital and intensive care are charged by the day; an NPC's first aid on your character comes with a paramedic's bill and a Pay button. A paid-up DocWagon Gold or Platinum contract takes 10 or 50 percent off care.
SR2E.Guide.Topic.rulesV096Health.b2.i3: Healing spells: Treat and Heal must be sustained for 5, 10, 15 or 20 Combat Turns by the wound; successes left after healing every box shorten that time.
SR2E.Guide.Topic.rulesV096Health.b2.i4: Patches: dermal armor lowers a patch's rating, blood filtration stops all but the trauma patch. A magician using a stim patch rolls Magic against its rating. An antidote patch on someone dying of a toxin lets the GM stabilise them.
SR2E.Guide.Topic.rulesV096Health.b2.i5: Bioware: a nephritic screen takes 1 Power off diseases and injected toxins; a trauma damper turns one box of a Physical hit into Stun; a pain editor's wearer isn't knocked out by Stun.
SR2E.Guide.Topic.rulesV096Health.b2.i6: Addiction: the addiction tests come when a dose wears off. A drug can be both physically and mentally addictive. In forced withdrawal the rating drops by 1 a day. Each week addicted the GM gets a card for the Essence lost. After a recovery comes a rest of the drug's rating in days at +1.
SR2E.Guide.Topic.rulesV096Health.b2.i7: DocWagon and neuro-stun: a DocWagon call rolls the unit and 3D6 minutes (the GM adds the area). Neuro-stun disorients for an hour (+2 to every target number) even when resisted.
